title: Community Resilience Microgrant
summary: Funds grassroots projects improving resilience to climate-driven disasters in vulnerable communities.

title: Youth STEAM Innovation Fund
summary: Supports programs blending science, technology, engineering, arts, and math to empower young innovators.
eligibility: Operates in Title I school districts or equivalent

title: Clean Energy Accelerator Grant
summary: Invests in workforce training and deployment of community-scale clean energy projects.

title: Health Equity Innovation Award
summary: Backs community-led innovations addressing systemic barriers to health care access.

title: Digital Literacy Expansion Fund
summary: Expands digital literacy and access to technology in underserved communities.

title: Local Food Systems Resilience Grant
summary: Supports community-based food production and distribution projects improving local food access.

title: Women in Tech Leadership Fellowship
summary: Empowers women pursuing leadership roles in technology and entrepreneurship.
eligibility: At least one prior program cycle completed

title: Arts for Social Change Grant
summary: Funds artists and organizations using creative expression to drive community conversations and social change.

title: Inclusive Entrepreneurship Fund
summary: Supports programs helping underrepresented entrepreneurs access capital, mentorship, and resources.
eligibility: Must serve minority-owned or women-led startups

title: Climate Tech Pilot Challenge
summary: Funds early-stage pilot projects using emerging tech to mitigate carbon emissions.

title: Accessible Education Infrastructure Fund
summary: Improves physical and digital accessibility in schools, libraries, and community centers.

title: Community College Innovation Grant
summary: Supports community colleges developing innovative programs that align workforce skills with emerging industries such as AI, sustainability, and healthcare.
eligibility: Evaluation and student outcome tracking plan

title: Public Health Preparedness Fund
summary: Enhances capacity of local health departments to prepare for and respond to public health emergencies.

title: STEM Education Access Challenge
summary: Expands equitable access to high-quality STEM education through teacher training and materials.

title: Sustainable Transportation Pilot Grant
summary: Funds local governments testing innovative mobility solutions that reduce emissions.

title: Veterans Career Advancement Fund
summary: Supports veteran-serving organizations providing job training and career services.
eligibility: Program must include career placement component

title: Urban Greening Partnership Grant
summary: Funds local projects creating urban green spaces, tree planting, and community gardens.

title: Inclusive Arts Fellowship
summary: Funds artists with disabilities and organizations promoting inclusive arts practices.

title: Water Innovation Research Fund
summary: Supports applied research in sustainable water technologies and community-based conservation.

title: Rural Broadband Expansion Grant
summary: Expands broadband access to rural communities lacking reliable internet infrastructure.
eligibility: Telecom providers, co-ops, or local governments

title: Creative Youth Empowerment Fund
summary: Empowers young people to lead creative projects that uplift their communities.

title: AI for Social Good Grant
summary: Funds projects using AI ethically to address social, environmental, or humanitarian challenges.

title: Neighborhood Safety and Design Grant
summary: Improves public safety and walkability through community-driven design improvements.

title: Senior Wellness Initiative Fund
summary: Supports programs improving quality of life, health, and social connection for older adults.

title: Environmental Justice Partnership Grant
summary: Funds grassroots coalitions addressing environmental injustices affecting marginalized populations.
